name: material-design-3-ui
title_zh: 用 Material 3 规范设计、审查并交付 UI
tagline_zh: 从组件选择到 Figma 规格，全程对齐 Google M3 规范。自动做无障碍审计，适配响应式布局。
tagline_en: From component pick to Figma-ready specs, stay aligned with Google M3. Auto accessibility audits and adaptive.
desc_en: Design, redesign, review, or implement user interfaces using Google Material Design 3 (M3), Material You, and optional Material 3 Expressive principles. Use for UI/UX screens, app flows, design systems, component selection, theming, responsive/adaptive layouts, accessibility audits, Figma-ready specifications, or developer handoff where Material Design 3 is required.
why_zh: 不只是给组件清单，而是把 M3 的令牌、动效和布局规则内化成决策引擎，能对现有界面做差异审查。
why_en: It's not a component list — it internalizes M3 tokens, motion, and layout rules into a decision engine that audits existing UIs.
limit_zh: 只认 Material Design 3 体系，不覆盖 iOS HIG、Bootstrap 或自定义设计系统。
limit_en: M3 only — no iOS HIG, Bootstrap, or custom systems. Outputs spec-level advice, not runnable code. Needs screenshots or structured descriptions.
